mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering the blood and then recovering useful substances was most worthwhile. It showed why the kidneys do more than just remove waste.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the ureters and bladder was clear but fairly predictable, since the pictures and slots showed where they went.

surprise.text: I was surprised that glucose and other useful small substances pass through the filter along with waste and have to be recovered.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures explained the connections and the recovery step.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: following the fluid from filtering to the bladder made me curious about how other body systems work together.
